Read and follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before making changes. Current behavior is specified in `SPEC.md`; planned work is in `docs/ROADMAP.md`. Edit lesson/syntax/example content with `node tools/content.mjs extract|check|inject`. After any change to `app.html`, run `node tools/build-offline.mjs` (never edit `offline/` by hand). Run `node tools/check.mjs` before proposing a change.
